prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt our watch workout summary to Always On presentation. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: watchOS on hardware supporting Always On. The wrist-down state runs a pulsing second-by-second animation, retains the full private heart-rate history at maximum brightness and shows no clear transition on wrist raise. Data refresh is not guaranteed while dimmed.

criteria.task_completion: Patch a dimmed, glanceable privacy-aware state with reduced animation/detail, valid time handling and a clear active-state return; qualify hardware and runtime assumptions.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the always-on guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch a dimmed, glanceable privacy-aware state with reduced animation/detail, valid time handling and a clear active-state return; qualify hardware and runtime assumptions.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch a dimmed, glanceable privacy-aware state with reduced animation/detail, valid time handling and a clear active-state return; qualify hardware and runtime assumptions.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
